body: variable length arrays in C++ are a Clang extension. According to our linter our coding style can't use this.
I could put in a less janky solution that just leaves nodes at their original position on the graph instead if you think that would be better.
Gotcha, I'll fix that right up!
I'm merely terrified of some edge case that leaves some nodes at the "invalid" location and it would have bad usability to fix.
This is fixed now, if something goes terribly wrong, nodes will just be left in their original positions.
